accepted.quote: The Child Care for Working Families Act would tackle the child care crisis head-on: ensuring families can afford the child care they need, expanding access to more high-quality options, stabilizing the child care sector, and helping ensure child care workers taking care of our nation's kids are paid livable wages.
accepted.bill: H.R. 4418, the Child Care for Working Families Act
accepted.rationale: The quote endorses expanded affordable child care and higher wages for workers as the solution to the crisis.
